notes: Independent broker specializing in distribution routes (Wise Snacks, Flowers Bread, Bimbo Bread, etc.). Server-rendered ASP.NET site with table-based listings. Each listing includes route number, type, pricing (total and down payment), weekly net income, location, and detailed descriptions. No pagination detected on main page - all 59 listings appear on single page. Listings can be clicked to view detail pages (RouteListDetail.aspx?RouteID=X).
